custodyProfile.uncertainty: At Ethereum block 26098754 on 2026-10-01, all eight withdrawal-queue markets were enumerated. Seven funded positions lend USDC against cbBTC, WBTC, wstETH or WETH at 86% LLTV; the idle market has zero supply shares. Every vault position has zero borrow shares and zero posted collateral. The exact immutable MetaMorpho source exposes supply and withdrawal operations, with no borrowing, collateral-supply or authorization-granting surface. Gauntlet's disclaimer states that its vaults are not custodial products and that Gauntlet is not a custodian. These observations establish on-chain custody, absence of local vault leverage and disclosed lending reuse at this block; they do not establish legal segregation or insolvency rights. Parent USDC reserve custody remains separate inherited exposure. The shared wrapper-allocation review, rather than these legal-custody enums, owns the structural on-chain assessment.
